smart_display YouTube Transcript

Extract and index transcripts/captions from YouTube videos. The transcript will be fetched automatically from YouTube's caption system.

YouTube Video URL check_circle Supports youtube.com/watch?v=, youtu.be/, and embed URLs YouTube URL is required. Please enter a valid YouTube URL.
Preferred Language {{ lang.name }} ({{ lang.code }}) If available, transcript in this language will be fetched Save transcript file info_outline
info
Note: YouTube transcript extraction works best with videos that have:
  • Auto-generated captions (most videos)
  • Manually added subtitles
  • Community-contributed captions
Videos without any captions cannot have transcripts extracted.

forum Discord Messages

Import messages from a Discord server or channel. Requires a Discord bot token with message read permissions.

Server ID check_circle Right-click server > Copy Server ID (enable Developer Mode in settings) Server ID is required. Please enter a valid Discord ID (17-19 digits). Channel ID (Optional) check_circle Leave empty to fetch from all accessible channels Please enter a valid Discord ID (17-19 digits). Bot Token check_circle Bot must have MESSAGE_CONTENT and READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY intents Bot token is required.
Message Limit {{ limit.label }} Maximum number of messages to fetch per channel
Include thread messages info_outline Save messages file info_outline
info
Setup Instructions:
  1. Create a bot at Discord Developer Portal
  2. Enable MESSAGE_CONTENT and SERVER_MEMBERS intents
  3. Invite the bot to your server with Read Message History permissions
  4. Copy the bot token from the Bot settings page

chat Slack Channel Messages

Import messages from a Slack channel. Requires a Slack Bot OAuth token with the channels:history scope.

article Confluence Pages

Import pages from your Confluence workspace. Connect using your Atlassian API token to access and index Confluence content.

Confluence Base URL check_circle Your Confluence Cloud or Server URL (e.g., https://company.atlassian.net/wiki) Confluence URL is required. Please enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
Email Address email Email is required. Please enter a valid email address. API Token vpn_key API token is required.
Space Key folder_special The key of the Confluence space to import (found in the space URL) Space key is required.
Include child pages info_outline Include attachments info_outline
info
Getting an API Token:
  1. Go to Atlassian API Tokens
  2. Click "Create API token"
  3. Give it a name and copy the generated token
Note: The token is tied to your Atlassian account and provides access to spaces you have permission to view.
